chunks: My father narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-‘Aṭṭār, from Ḥamdān ibn Sulaymān al-Naysābūrī, from ‘Abdillāh ibn Muḥammad al-Yamānī, from Manī‘ ibn al-Ḥajjāj, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, from Ṣafwān ibn Mihrān al-Jammāl, from Abū ‘Abdillāh (peace be upon him) who said:

Whoever visits the grave of al-Ḥusayn (peace be upon him) while seeking (nearness to) Allāh, the Great and Almighty, will be accompanied by Jibra’īl, Mīkā’īl, and Isrāfīl until he is returned to his home.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for visiting the grave of Imam al-Husayn with sincerity?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarat, Ibn Qulawayh records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) to emphasize the cosmic significance of visiting Imam al-Husayn (a.s.), linking the physical act of ziyarah to divine accompaniment. The presence of the three chief archangels—Jibril, Mikail, and Israfil—symbolizes the highest level of spiritual honor and divine approval for the pilgrim. This tradition underscores the Shia belief that the graves of the Imams serve as spiritual portals where the boundary between the earthly and celestial realms is temporarily bridged for the sincere believer.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 4. Those who go to the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) seeking (nearness to) Allāh, the Great and Almighty, will be accompanied by Jabra`īl, Mīkā`īl, and Isrāfīl until they return to their homes.
